briefdescription.para: Sets the april tag family to detect.

detaileddescription.para: If override is true, the AI vision sensor will only look for the given family. Otherwise, it will add the given tag to the list of enabled tags.

This function uses the following values of errno when an error state is reached: ENXIO - The given value is not within the range of V5 ports (1-21). ENODEV - The port cannot be configured as a vision sensor

parameterdescription.para: the tag family to configure the AI Vision sensor to detect
if true, the given family will be set as the only enabled tag family.

simplesect.para: PROS_SUCCESS if the operation was successful or PROS_ERR if the operation failed, setting errno.

briefdescription.para: Set a color configuration that the AI vision sensor will detect.

detaileddescription.para: The color detection type must be separately enabled. If a color with the same ID already is stored in the sensor, it will be overwritten.

This function uses the following values of errno when an error state is reached: ENXIO - The given value is not within the range of V5 ports (1-21). ENODEV - The port cannot be configured as a vision sensor

parameterdescription.para: the color to configure the AI Vision sensor to detect

simplesect.para: PROS_SUCCESS if the operation was successful or PROS_ERR if the operation failed, setting errno

briefdescription.para: Get a color configuration that the AI vision sensor has stored.

detaileddescription.para: If you attempt to get a color configuration that has not been previously used, the behavior is not defined.

This function uses the following values of errno when an error state is reached: ENXIO - The given value is not within the range of V5 ports (1-21). ENODEV - The port cannot be configured as a vision sensor

#define AIVISION_PORT 1 void opcontrol() { pros::AIVision aivision(AIVISION_PORT); AIVision::Code color = aivision.get_color(0); printf("id: %d, red: %d, green: %d, blue: %d, hue_range: %f, saturation_range: %f\n", color.id, color.red, color.green, color.blue, color.hue_range, color.saturation_range); }

simplesect.para: PROS_SUCCESS if the operation was successful or PROS_ERR if the operation failed, setting errno

briefdescription.para: Set a code that the AI vision sensor will detect for.

This function uses the following values of errno when an error state is reached: ENXIO - The given value is not within the range of V5 ports (1-21). ENODEV - The port cannot be configured as a vision sensor

simplesect.para: PROS_SUCCESS if the operation was successful or PROS_ERR if the operation failed, setting errno

briefdescription.para: Get a code that the AI vision sensor has stored.

briefdescription.para: Get a class name that the AI vision sensor has stored.

detaileddescription.para: The AI Vision sensor may not correctly report classnames for the first several hundred milliseconds of being plugged in. By passing in -1 for the id, the function will return the number of class names the AI vision sensor reports. For other values of id, the function return value is undefined

parameterdescription.para: the id of the class name from 0-(AIVISION_MAX_CLASSNAME_COUNT - 1)
a string of length >=20 to store the classname.

simplesect.para: PROS_SUCCESS if the operation was successful or PROS_ERR if the operation failed, setting errno
